text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api eu-west1 - GPU pool at 99% util, request-queue depth rising fast. p95=6.2s p99=31.4s. Paging #oncall
aisha: Seeing a weird traffic shape — not gradual, came in spikes. queue ~18k and growing. dashboards show a new referrer (marketing/campaign)
marco: Confirming GPU provisioner logs show repeated create failures: rate limit 429 from cloud provider. Provisioner backoff stuck at 10s.
ryan: Can we push to other regions or spin reserve pool? What's the autoscaler health?
aisha: Autoscaler controller shows leader lock flips, reconciler stuck on some shard. Logs: `err=failed to allocate instance: quotaExceeded`
eve: Support: early reports of timeouts from a handful of customers, some 504s. CS triage says approx 12% requests failing to complete in last 6m.
marco: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) enable degraded model routing for non-enterprise tenants, 2) apply emergency regional throttles for campaign referrer, 3) move some traffic to dedicated pools if capacity exists. Which is fastest?
aisha: Degraded model routing is quick — flip `routing.policy.degraded=true` for hosted-api route. That drops GPU memory footprint, should free up slots. I'll run.
marco: I'm going to temporarily increase provisioner parallelism but cloud rate limit may still block. Running: ```
# bump provisioner parallelism
kubectl -n infra patch deploy/provisioner -p '{"spec":{"replicas":5}}'
# attempt emergency scale
redwoodctl provision --region eu-west1 --pool hosted-gpu --add 8
```
aisha: Routing flip done. Observability: queue depth flattened-ish but p95 still elevated (2.8s) p99 down to ~14s. Progressing.
eve: Notifying top-20 enterprise customers. Adding note to status page: partial degradation for non-enterprise traffic.
ops-bot: Applied temporary rate-limit rule: `X-Referrer: marketing` -> 10r/s per tenant.
marco: Cloud returned a few more VMs but provisioner still reporting intermittent 429s. Need quota escalation. I'm opening a support case (provider ticket #CT-19831).
ryan: I'll take the on-call for next hour. @aisha you can hand back when stable. Start timeline and collect metrics for postmortem.
aisha: Handing over to ryan. key actions taken: degraded routing, campaign throttling, provisioner bump, raised provider ticket.
ryan: Oncall here — watching queue and p99. If queue growth resumes, we'll cut non-critical background jobs and enable routing fallback to edge cache.
eve: Incidents page updated. CS messaging queued.
marco: Provider has temporarily raised soft quota via support, new instances coming up. autoscaler reconciler restarted to pick up new capacity: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/autoscaler`
aisha: After autoscaler restart, pool gradually filled. p99 back to ~6s -> trending down. Queue now ~6k.
ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Tracker: INC-2024-317
ryan: We'll keep paged if p99>10s. Otherwise monitor for 2h then hand to normal oncall. Please add any followups to the incident thread.
aisha: Postmortem action items: - investigate provisioner backoff logic for long 429 loops - add campaign referrer anomaly alert - add fast-path for degraded-model routing in routing plane - confirm quota limits with provider for peak campaigns
marco: Saved relevant logs: `/var/log/provisioner/2024-...` and attached to ticket.
eve: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~12% error rate over 8 minutes, primary impact on non-enterprise traffic, no data loss.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident moved to monitoring. Last update recorded.
